question: Should QQBot adopt a 16 MiB hard inbound WebSocket-frame limit despite the absence of a published QQ gateway maximum, accepting reconnects for larger otherwise-valid events?
rationale: The implementation is mechanically small and the proof demonstrates its behavior, but selecting a permanent protocol cutoff changes what events an existing QQBot deployment can receive.

options.title: Approve the 16 MiB contract
options.body: Accept the proposed pre-parse memory bound and its documented reconnect behavior for frames above 16 MiB.

options.title: Choose a different documented ceiling
options.body: Provide a QQ-specific supported maximum, then update the constant, proof, and tests to match that contract.

options.title: Keep the current ws default
options.body: Decline the compatibility trade-off until a supported QQ gateway maximum or production requirement supports a bounded cutoff.

recommendation.title: Approve the 16 MiB contract
recommendation.body: Accept the proposed pre-parse memory bound and its documented reconnect behavior for frames above 16 MiB.
